sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Bipin Kumar Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Om Prakash Gupta,Priyavrat Tripathi
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
Heard Mr. Bipin Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government
Advocate representing the State and Mr. Om Prakash Gupta, learned counsel appearing on behalf of
the first informant/complainant.

By means of this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant Tribhuwan, who is involved in
Case Crime No. 265 of 2019 (S.T. No. 81 of 2020), under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc and Section 3/4
Dowry Prohibition Act, police station Kothibhar, district Maharajganj, seeks enlargement on bail
during the pendency of trial.

At the outset, it is pointed out by learned counsel for the informant that in this case, first information report was lodged on 27.09.2019 and charge-sheet was submitted on 28.11.2019 and thereafter, charges were framed on 13.02.2020 and till date, five prosecution witnesses have been examined.

Tribhuwan vs State Of U.P. on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140830743/
1
The aforesaid fact with regard to present status of the trial has not been disputed by learned counsel for the applicant.
However, he submits that since the applicant is in jail since 29.09.2019, trial Court may be directed to expedite the trial of the applicant.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find that there is no dispute between the parties that till date, five prosecution witnesses have been examined and trial is proceeding, therefore, I do not find any good ground to release the applicant on bail at this stage.
Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.

However, considering the detention period of the applicant as noted above, the trial Court is directed to make an endeavour to conclude the trial of the applicant, expeditiously, preferably within a period of nine months from the date of production of a copy of this order without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.
Order Date :- 18.1.2023 Shubham  Tribhuwan vs State Of U.P. on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140830743/
